summary: This Section B excerpt of the TICO Texas Statistical Plan for Residential Risks specifies coding requirements for premiums and losses effective with the 2026 plan, including state, statistical-plan, line-of-business, form, occupancy, construction, protection, deductible, loss, cause-of-loss, claims-history, ZIP, endorsement, and rating-variable codes. The document is primarily a catalog of required reporting code lists and interpretive instructions for how insurers must select codes in residential risk statistical reporting.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Statistical Plan Code
proposed_nodes.description: Residential Risk – Dwellings – Homeowners (HO) is reported with code 4.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — State Code
proposed_nodes.description: Texas is reported with state code 42.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Kind Codes — Losses
proposed_nodes.description: Loss record kind codes 1–9 distinguish records with no current payment/outstanding loss, reopened claims with paid loss, claims not reopened with paid loss, and records reporting outstanding loss amounts, including whether previously reported closed with payment or without payment.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Line of Business
proposed_nodes.description: Line-of-business codes include homeowners tenants/condo owners 02, homeowners excluding tenants 03, dwelling fire/property/time element 10, miscellaneous property schedules 11, liability 12, TWIA wind-only 13, voluntary wind-only 14–15, theft 16, extended coverage/V&MM loss-only 20, loss assessment 25, additional extended coverage 26, residence glass 27, all risk physical loss 28, private flood 29 or 35, supplemental natural disaster protection 50, and TWIA surcharges 77.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Policy Forms
proposed_nodes.description: Policy form codes for homeowners, tenant, condominium, dwelling, ISO, AAIS, and independent forms. Includes legacy homeowners/tenants codes 1–5 and 9, and other approved form codes A–Z plus 6, 7, and 8.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Number of Families
proposed_nodes.description: Codes classify 1 or 2 family homeowners and dwelling risks, personal-property-only dwelling risks, tenants forms with or without $250 optional theft deductible, and combined dwelling/personal property.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Coverage — Occupancy
proposed_nodes.description: Occupancy and coverage codes 1–9 classify owner/non-owner occupied homeowners, tenants contents/apartment/all other/liability-only forms, residential condominium contents, vacant occupancy, premium-bearing endorsements, and dwelling fire/extended coverage small-mercantile occupancy. Code 7 requires TICO approval before use.
proposed_nodes.notes: Before using code 7 for all policies with vacant occupancy, an insurer must receive approval from TICO.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Construction
proposed_nodes.description: Construction codes: frame 1, brick/stone veneer 2, brick/stone/masonry 3, fire resistive/semi fire resistive 4, mobile or manufactured home 5, stucco or asbestos 8, not applicable 9. Text defines construction classifications and predominant-construction rules for mixed construction risks.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Roof Covering
proposed_nodes.description: Roof covering codes A–P classify predominant roof covering: composition shingle, wood, aluminum, steel, copper, roll roofing, tar and gravel, tile, slate, fiber cement/concrete, plastic, recycled products, single-ply membrane, other, metal type unknown, and unknown/not used in rating.
proposed_nodes.notes: Applies excluding tenants and condominium; insurer chooses one category best fitting the predominant roof covering.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Roof Credit
proposed_nodes.description: Roof credit codes: 0 none/no applicable credit or non-UL2218 roof; 1 Class 1; 2 Class 2; 3 Class 3; 4 Class 4. Only premium credits for roof coverings meeting UL2218 or other TDI-approved standards are reported. Roof year must be reported in YYYY format, or 0000 if not used in underwriting or rating.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Cosmetic Roof Damage Exclusion Endorsement
proposed_nodes.description: Endorsement attachment codes: 0 endorsement is not attached; 1 endorsement is attached.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — ISO Public Protection Class
proposed_nodes.description: Report ISO PPC if used in rating. Codes are 1–9, A, and B, where A reports PPC 10 and B reports PPC 8B.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — ISO PPC New Split Classifications
proposed_nodes.description: Split-classification PPC codes include 01–10 and split classifications 12, 13, 19, 20, 22, 23, 32, 33, 42, 43, 52, 53, 62, 63, 72, 73, 82, and 83.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: ISO Public Protection Class Including New Split Classifications

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Deductible Type or Amount
proposed_nodes.description: Deductible codes for homeowners and dwellings include 1 full coverage, 2 $100, 3 $250, 4 1/2%, 5 1%, 6 $500, 7 no wind coverage, 8 $1,000, 9 greater than 10%, A 1-1/2%, B 2%, C 2-1/2%, D 3%, E 4%, F 5%, G $1,500, H $2,000, I $2,500, J $3,000, K $4,000, L $5,000, M $750, N 10%, O $3,500, P $7,500, Q $10,000, R 6%, S 7%, T 8%, U 9%, V $25,000, W $50,000, X $100,000 or greater, Y $200, and Z $15,000. Notes specify seacoast code 1 treatment and code 7 wind-exclusion territories. Additional rules specify how to choose the deductible code when multiple coverages, buildings, property items, or perils apply.
proposed_nodes.notes: For seacoast territories 1, 8, 9, 10, and 11, code 1 means $100 deductible on wind, hurricane, and hail with full coverage on other extended coverage perils. Code 7 applies in specified catastrophe-area territories subject to Wind Exclusion Endorsement.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Type of Loss Code
proposed_nodes.description: Homeowners type-of-loss codes: code 1 for Section I dwellings, Section I unscheduled personal property, Section II personal liability, Section II medical payments, and certain basic-policy watercraft losses; code 3 for losses from individual company enhancement endorsements; code 2 for other additional-premium endorsement losses excluding enhancement endorsements.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Cause of Loss Codes
proposed_nodes.description: Homeowners and dwellings cause-of-loss codes include fire internal 05, fire external including lightning fire 10, fire unknown 15, lightning no fire 20, windstorm 25, hail 30, flood or rising water 32, explosion 33, smoke 35, aircraft/vehicles 40, riot/civil commotion 45, vandalism/malicious mischief 50, collapse 55, water/steam discharge damage to slab/foundation 60, other water/steam damage 61, freeze damage to slab/foundation 70, other freeze damage 71, burglary/theft/robbery 75, other physical damage 80, and liability/medical payments 90. Code must reflect original and proximate cause, not ensuing causes.
proposed_nodes.notes: Examples direct tornado roof and ensuing rain losses to windstorm, and frozen pipe burst losses to freeze.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Prior Claims History
proposed_nodes.description: Prior claims history codes: 0 no chargeable claims in last five years; 1–4 for one to four claims; 5 for five or more; 6 for company does not use prior claims history in rating or tiering.

proposed_nodes.name: Field Requirement — ZIP Code
proposed_nodes.format: Five-digit ZIP code; ZIP+4 if available
proposed_nodes.notes: No record-layout position is provided in Section B; extracted as a field requirement because the rule states the ZIP code must be reported.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Building Code Credits (TWIA Only)
proposed_nodes.description: TWIA-only building code credit codes: 01 seaward new structure built to new code; 02 seaward retrofitted; 03 Inland I new structure built to new code; 04 Inland I new structure built to higher standards than new code; 05 Inland I retrofitted; 06 Inland II built to Inland I standard; 07 Inland II built to seaward standard; 08 Inland II retrofitted; 09 not applicable.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Law and Ordinance Coverage
proposed_nodes.description: Law and ordinance coverage codes: 0 no additional coverage attached other than policy-provided amount; 1 10% additional coverage purchased; 2 15%; 3 25%; 4 other approved limits purchased.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Optional Credit Personal Property ID
proposed_nodes.description: Optional personal property ID credit codes: 0 credit does not apply; 1 credit applies.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Optional Coverage Endorsements
proposed_nodes.description: For optional coverage endorsements providing coverage for mold, water, foundation, or flood, report the actual endorsement number excluding dashes, such as HO161, HO162, TDP004, or TDP005. Use additional records as necessary.
proposed_nodes.notes: The text describes a reporting code convention based on actual endorsement number rather than a finite enumerated list.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Amount of Coverage for Optional Coverage Endorsement
proposed_nodes.description: Reports the percent or dollar amount, as applicable, for optional coverage endorsement.
proposed_nodes.code_list_name: Amount of Coverage for Optional Coverage Endorsement
proposed_nodes.notes: The source shows an asterisk as the code placeholder rather than enumerating values.

proposed_nodes.name: Code List — Use of Certain Rating Variables
proposed_nodes.description: One-digit rating variable use codes for listed variables such as alarm, age of home, sprinkler, loss/claims experience, companion policy, credit-based insurance score, senior citizen, smart/connected home, new/recently purchased home, and additional risk surcharges: 1 used in rating with no discount/surcharge; 2 discount or factor <1.000; 3 surcharge or factor >1.000; 4 used to place policy in rating tier; 5 insurer does not use variable in rating or tiering.

proposed_nodes.name: Endorsement Rule — Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings
proposed_nodes.form_name: Exclusion of Cosmetic Damage to Roof Coverings Endorsement
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Excludes cosmetic damage to roof coverings when attached; reported with attachment indicator code 1 versus 0 if not attached.

proposed_nodes.name: Endorsement Rule — Wind Exclusion Endorsement
proposed_nodes.coverage_effect: Wind coverage excluded for deductible code 7 in specified territories/catastrophe area.
